semiconductor_relevance: High — Systems Engineering Inc. specializes in optical measurement tools for semiconductor material characterization, which are critical for the manufacturing process.
summary: Systems Engineering Inc. manufactures advanced FT-IR SE 50 series tools designed for high-precision measurement of semiconductor materials. Their products support various applications, including the analysis of film thickness and elemental composition in semiconductor wafers and ingots.
capabilities: FT-IR SE 50 series semiconductor material characterization tools
Automatic multipoint measurement systems for wafers
High-precision measurement of boron, phosphorus, hydrogen, and other elements in films
Compatibility with various wafer sizes (2-12 inches)
